implementedPolicy.los: finite segment test against actual loaded _colbox_ triangles; endpoint contacts are excluded; floor helper triangles do not occlude
implementedPolicy.route: dh2::floors::find_path over the supplied same sewn world with original PF flags/radius; dh2_nav_move_path advances its retained per-actor PathObject
implementedPolicy.approach: validate each current owner-to-waypoint segment against actual loaded _colbox_ triangles; blocked segments select idle. Otherwise apply original PFWorld ValidateDirection to the heading using this actor's retained PF position/radius/flags and the same sewn floor world's CollisionWorld, then LookTowards and select caller-provided retained walk locomotion; no direct position writes
implementedPolicy.boundary_heading: source Character construction defaults validate_boundary to 1; an explicit ActorState source_validate_boundary452 value overrides that default. The source direction diagnostic bit is ignored while any original edge-slide mutation is still published, matching UpdatePath
implementedPolicy.stop: drop the actor route and select caller-provided retained idle locomotion when the combat pose is not owned
implementedPolicy.tracked_target_retention: source strict ViewRadius test for an already tracked target; collision LOS remains an acquisition gate only
implementedPolicy.attack_handoff: controller invokes stop once on approach-to-melee transition before request_actor_attack, and does not repeat stop during an owned attack pose

blurRouteReleaseAudit.source_order: CSMove::OnBlur calls GameObject::Stop then Pin. GameObject::Stop calls PFWorld::DropPath first; for a nonempty path DropPath copies current PF position into requested target, then GameObject Stop copies its position into destination, clears movement/path-request and heading-active state and zeroes heading direction. Physical Stop follows only when the physical object exists and the virtual moving predicate is nonzero.
blurRouteReleaseAudit.modern_seam: RuntimeEnemyNavigationV1::release_route(CombatSession&, ActorId, error) erases only this adapter’s cached route after validating a live same-Session actor. It does not select Idle, sample/select animation, mutate ActorState/PF/physical fields, or reproduce DropPath’s nonempty-path requested-target copy. Root/main own accepted transition policy and actual physical Stop.
blurRouteReleaseAudit.focused_test_plan: The private native regression uses the actual live Swamp lizard/player records in one CombatSession, loads the authored Swamp floor BRES, builds/sews its floor graph, and attaches the same graph/storage to the lizard’s actual PlayableActorBodies PF object. approach builds a nonempty route before failing closed at the unavailable initialized source locomotion bank. release_route is checked for no actor transform/action/target/pose-ownership change, then approach is called again and must rebuild the route. Empty-route idempotence and unknown actor rejection are also checked.
blurRouteReleaseAudit.status: Implemented and privately tested. Route release/rebuild is verified on the same Session actor and sewn Swamp floor/PF owners. This fixture does not prove the source requested-target copy or full GameObject.Stop; it also reaches the explicitly missing source locomotion-bank boundary after route construction.

unsupported_or_unverified: CollisionScene loader omits hidden or conditional modules until their existing loader admits them, and does not include dynamic actors or other non-mesh occluders.
LOS endpoints use ActorState positions; native target-node/eye-height and interaction-query semantics are not proven.
Source navigation cadence, search ordering, route tie-breaking, special avoidance and list60 policy remain unclaimed.
The shared floor route kernel does not expose alternate path search constrained by _colbox_ geometry here; a blocked waypoint is rejected and stopped, not replanned around a static obstacle.
No original controller Debug DisableWallAvoidance provider is connected; generic monster movement uses the recovered Character boundary-validation default.

The caller must pass the exact SourceNavigationWorldStorage used by PlayableActorBodies.initialize_navigation and the currently loaded scene collision; the adapter fails when either identity or geometry readiness cannot be verified.
The adapter does not bind itself into root CombatSession::ActorDecisionProvider, load locomotion clips, or execute a native Character Level InitPost lifecycle.
